title: Best Financial Comparison Site, Middle East, 2014: Souqalmal.com
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: The CFI.co Judging Panel considers Souqalmal.com to be a highly credible and accomplished site noting that, ‘this award winner clearly has integrity and is doing a superb job. Souqalmal.com is a young company that has grown phenomenally since its establishment two years ago and its site is available in the English language as well as Arabic.’
